message: Evaluate if this idea is already solved and write down the answer in the idea

plan.goal: Check whether the selected synchronization-free anti-collapse idea (latent-recovery/encoder channel independent of discriminator staleness) has already been solved or closely anticipated in the literature.

args.query: Has mode collapse in GANs already been addressed by a discriminator-independent anti-collapse mechanism, such as an encoder-based latent-recovery/invertibility penalty (e.g. InfoGAN, BiGAN/ALI, VEEGAN) that is explicitly tested for robustness when the discriminator falls out of sync or is stale relative to the generator?

steps.why: This is a prior-art question answerable from the literature, not from further thinking about the idea itself.

done_criteria: the investigator returns findings addressing whether a discriminator-independent anti-collapse mechanism has been published
the findings identify at least one closely related prior work (e.g. VEEGAN/InfoGAN/BiGAN) or state none was found
the findings note whether desynchronization-robustness specifically (not just mode collapse generally) has been tested in prior work
